goal: Prepare each final pre-race check ten minutes before jump, then run a bounded watch for interim and official placings. Preserve the last pre-race tip; use only official earlier results for later-race learning. Respect shared locks, source cooldowns and Retry-After.

notes.type: tip / trainer / gear / rider / scratching / track / stewards

access.acquire: Use Sites get_site for this linked Site to obtain its current siwc_bypass_bearer_token. Do not create or rotate tokens.
access.send: Only to this exact Site. OAI-Sites-Authorization: Bearer <token> for platform access, plus Authorization: Bearer <token> for the protected update route. Keep tokens in tool memory and supply them via hidden stdin, never shell arguments, files or output.
access.helper: /late-mail-updater.py accepts JSON via hidden stdin. For a race slot: {token,mode:"watch",race:N,notes:[source-backed notes]}. For the final wrap: {token,mode:"update",payload:{runKey:"2026-11-07-final-HHMM",phase:"final",notes:[]}}. Download the current helper, not an old cached client.
access.on401: Do not bypass authorization or rotate credentials. Report the failed update and retain the old edition.

research.primary: TABtouch nine fixed race pages, https://www.tabtouch.com.au/racing/2026-11-07/mr/{1..9}. The writer fetches current fields, gear declarations, guide selection, going, source start times and official dividends itself.
check: Late scratchings and final-field status; do not promote emergencies without confirmation.
Declared gear versus newly announced changes; ambiguous source wording stays flagged.
Rider, barrier and carried-weight changes; vet/stewards reports.
Current reported going and weather. Rain alone is not a surface rating.
Latest sourced guide/trainer views. Preserve publication date; re-fetching old mail does not make it new.
Official results from earlier races, with no provisional-result influence.

Check accessible direct X/Twitter posts for genuinely fresh race tips. Verify author, exact selection and publication time within3 hours; store direct status URL and published ISO time, not a search snippet or account page. No invented quote or posting time.
research.limits: Do not fabricate tips, quotes, prices, certainty, independent votes or numerical gear/jockey bonuses. Keep each note <=15 words and all derived paraphrases <=100 words per article. Never copy an article. Unsupported or contradictory claims are omitted or explicitly marked uncertain.

execution: Read the current plan and /api/late-mail. Choose the matching assigned pre-race slot using Australia/Melbourne time. The existing A/B tasks run at least an hour apart within each task. At the final-wrap slot use phase final and fetch only unresolved races.

Check concise, current late mail for the matching race through the listed sources. Preserve publication dates and unverified track forecasts. Send at most 30 short source-backed notes; do not convert a forecast into the reported going.

Run the fixed-Site helper in mode watch for this race. It checks pre-race once, follows a short defer if still before jump, then checks results near +3,+6,+10,+20 minutes. It honours later Retry-After/cooldowns, stops at official/abandoned, and ends within 45 minutes. Keep the process alive and inspect output at intervals no longer than 60 seconds; do not kill it merely because it is waiting. Each internal sleep is at most 30 seconds.

A successful pre-phase check in the ten-minute window now prepares the sourced thirty-second race briefing automatically in previews[race]. Verify it exists after the saved check. Do not create it after jump. The homepage welcome has embedded synthetic English narration; race briefings use captions and an English device narrator where supported. Do not claim the real Geoff or the named editorial guests recorded these voices.

Access comes from Sites get_site for this project. Download the helper/instructions from the same exact Site using its OAI-Sites-Authorization header. Keep access only in memory, supply it through hidden stdin, and never put it in arguments, files, source or notifications. On 401/403 from the Site, stop and report; do not rotate or bypass authorization.

The protected server serialises writers with an atomic conditional R2 lease. It selects only the target race plus at most one earlier unresolved race at pre-check, has a two-minute per-race minimum, three-second host spacing, 30 racing requests/hour and 90/day, and a thirty-minute weather minimum. It stops on 429/403/errors and applies persisted backoff. Do not independently hit the primary source around this policy.

Read back every successful saved edition. Interim placings must be labelled unconfirmed and must not change model learning, winner counts, tipster scores or payouts. Save and report official results only when the source confirms them. Never create hindsight selections after jump.

Give a concise update with pre-race changes and then the result/watch outcome, the saved tip versus baseline, reported going, sources and saved timestamp. If the result is still interim/pending, state that the bounded watch ended and the next scheduled check/final wrap can retry. Creation proves scheduling, not execution or guaranteed on-time results.

If start times move, the watch follows the saved verified time within its bound. Reschedule remaining A/B slots on these same linked tasks if needed, retaining at least an hour between each task’s runs. Do not create duplicate tasks or unlimited polling loops.

raceVideos.when: As soon as the initial saved ten-minute preview exists; run concurrently with the bounded result watch. Never wait until after jump to start a generation.
